verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a browser-automation service, but the evidence describes only a hosted cloud API and CLI with no documented self-hosted deployment. A community commenter explicitly asks the vendor to 'make it self-hostable' (smooth-comm-10), suggesting it is not. The 'self' P2P tunnel option (smooth-docs-12) only routes traffic through the user's machine, an adjacent feature that does not count as self-hosting the core product.
